name: Students
overview: The Scriptures reveal that students, particularly those known as the 'sons of the prophets,' were dedicated learners under the guidance of God-appointed leaders like Samuel and Elijah. These students were deeply involved in spiritual formation, as seen when Saul's messengers were overcome by the Spirit and prophesied alongside them (1 Samuel 19:20). The community of prophetic students was aware of divine transitions, such as the impending departure of Elijah, and remained obedient and silent in reverence (2 Kings 2:3, 2:5). Their commitment to learning and prophetic ministry is further illustrated by their collective witnessing of significant events, emphasizing their role as faithful disciples in God's work (2 Kings 2:7).
